profile.summary: CBRE Design Collective was a design practice within the commercial real estate firm CBRE. It offered interior design, architecture, engineering and experiential design services. In 2025 its U.S. team was announced as joining the architecture and design firm Ware Malcomb.

sources.title: Ware Malcomb Announces CBRE's U.S. Design Collective Will Join Firm
